meta.title-404: I selida den vrethike | GFTV HelloSpot
meta.description: Ekei opou oi neofermenoi kanoun neous filous se furmeet kai furry synedria. Apo to Global Furry Television.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.line: Episimos istotopos tou Global Furry Television
official.domain-heading: Oi episimoi istotopoi tou GFTV teleionoun se globalfurry.tv i gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Diavaste ti diefthynsi apo to telos, stin teleftaia teleia prin apo tin proti moni katheto. Enas istotopos pou teleionei se otidipote allo den einai tou GFTV, akomi ki an to onoma emfanizetai noritera sti diefthynsi.
official.trusted-link: I pliris lista ton episimon istotopon tou GFTV
official.secure-body: Anazitiste ena louketo i to https:// stin archi tis diefthynsis. Moirasteite prosopika stoicheia mono se episimo istotopo meso asfalous syndesis.
update.label: Enimerosi
update.ready: Mia nea ekdosi tou GFTV HelloSpot einai etoimi.
hero.card-alt: I karta onomatos tou HelloSpot. Grafei Hello kai 哈喽 dipla se ena megalo chamogelo, pano stis ouranies riges tou GFTV.
hero.title: Vrikate ena HelloSpot!
hero.lede: Se furmeet kai furry synedria, to HelloSpot einai to simeio opou oi neofermenoi kanoun neous filous.
how.title: Pos leitourgei ena HelloSpot
how.spot.title: Vreite to chamogelo
how.spot.body: Anazitiste to HelloSmile se mia karta, ena kordoni laimou i mia pinakida. Opou ki an einai, ekei einai ena HelloSpot.
how.hello.title: Peite geia
how.hello.body: Elate kai peite geia. Se ena HelloSpot kaneis den perimenei na gnorizete idi kapoion.
how.friend.title: Kante enan filo
how.friend.body: Gnoriste tous anthropous gyro sas kai fygete me kapoion na anazitisete stin epomeni synantisi.

about.eyebrow: Mia stigmi, ti einai to GFTV?
about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: To Global Furry Television (GFTV) einai to megalytero eidiseografiko kanali tou furry fandom stin Asia, me edra ti Sinkapouri.
about.body-2: Parousiazoume tin anaptyxi tis furry koinotitas gia na tin ektimoun oloi simera kai avrio, kai dimiourgoume chorous opou oi anthropoi boroun na gnorisoun kai na katanoisoun o enas ton allon.
about.body-3: Apo to spiti kai se oles tis megales ipeirous, i omada tou GFTV einai diethnis, polypolitismiki kai polyglossi.
outro.title: Ta leme sto epomeno HelloSpot!
